name: Woolly bluecurls
desc: Woolly bluecurls (Trichostema lanatum): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 241 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Trichostema lanatum, also known as woolly bluecurls, is a small evergreen shrub or sub-shrub native to arid coastal chaparral regions of California down to the northern tip of Baja California, Mexico.
